settings.heading: You're all
settings.text_1: We'll email you on Friday 20 November, the moment early access opens. You get first pick, a week before everyone else.
settings.text_2: For now, there's nothing else to do. We'll be in touch soon.
settings.wait_text: Have a read of the journal. The wines, the valley they come from, and what to cook with them.
settings.text_1_open: Your code is on its way to your inbox. One tap and it's in your basket.
settings.text_2_open: Early access runs until the end of Monday 23 November.
